121:     def fit_clothes_to_human(clothes, basemesh, mhclo=None, set_parent=True):
122:         """Move clothes vertices so they fit the current shape of the base mesh."""
123: 
124:         _LOG.dump("Given MHCLO object", mhclo)
125: 
126:         if basemesh is None:
127:             raise ValueError('Cannot refit to None basemesh')
128: 
129:         if clothes is None:
130:             raise ValueError('Cannot refit to None clothes')
131: 
132:         if not ObjectService.object_is_basemesh(basemesh):
133:             raise ValueError('The provided object is not a basemesh')
134: 
135:         if mhclo is None:
136:             mhclo_fragment = GeneralObjectProperties.get_value("asset_source", entity_reference=clothes)
137:             object_type = ObjectService.get_object_type(clothes)
138: 
139:             if mhclo_fragment and object_type:
140:                 mhclo_path = AssetService.find_asset_absolute_path(mhclo_fragment, str(object_type).lower())
141:                 if not mhclo_path:
142:                     raise IOError(mhclo_fragment + " does not exist")
143:                 if not os.path.exists(mhclo_path):
144:                     raise IOError(mhclo_path + " does not exist")
145:                 mhclo = Mhclo()
146:                 mhclo.load(mhclo_path)
147:             else:
148:                 raise ValueError('There is not enough info to refit this asset, at least asset source and object type is needed')
149:             mhclo.clothes = clothes
150: 
151:         if not mhclo.verts or len(mhclo.verts.keys()) < 1:
152:             raise ValueError('There is no vertex info in the MHCLO!?')
153: 
154:         # We cannot rely on the vertex position data directly, since it represent positions
155:         # as they are *before* targets are applied. We want the shape of the mesh *after*
156:         # targets are applied.
157:         #
158:         # We will therefore create a new shape key "from mix". This means it will have the
159:         # combined state of all current shape keys. Then we will use that shape key for
160:         # getting vertex positions.
161:         key_name = "temporary_fitting_key." + str(random.randrange(1000, 9999))
162:         basemesh.shape_key_add(name=key_name, from_mix=True)
163:         shape_key = basemesh.data.shape_keys.key_blocks[key_name]
164:         human_vertices = shape_key.data
165:         human_vertices_count = len(human_vertices)
166: 
167:         scale_factor = GeneralObjectProperties.get_value("scale_factor", entity_reference=basemesh)
168:         if not scale_factor:
169:             scale_factor = 1.0
170: 
171:         # Fallback for if no scale is specified in mhclo
172:         z_size = y_size = x_size = scale_factor
173: 
174:         if mhclo.x_scale:
175:             if mhclo.x_scale[0] >= human_vertices_count or mhclo.x_scale[1] > human_vertices_count \
176:                 or mhclo.y_scale[0] >= human_vertices_count or mhclo.y_scale[1] >= human_vertices_count \
177:                 or mhclo.z_scale[0] >= human_vertices_count or mhclo.z_scale[1] >= human_vertices_count:
178:                 _LOG.warn("Giving up refitting, not inside")
179:                 raise ValueError("Cannot refit as we are not inside")
180: 
181:             x_size = abs(human_vertices[mhclo.x_scale[0]].co[0] - human_vertices[mhclo.x_scale[1]].co[0]) / mhclo.x_scale[2]
182:             y_size = abs(human_vertices[mhclo.y_scale[0]].co[2] - human_vertices[mhclo.y_scale[1]].co[2]) / mhclo.y_scale[2]
183:             z_size = abs(human_vertices[mhclo.z_scale[0]].co[1] - human_vertices[mhclo.z_scale[1]].co[1]) / mhclo.z_scale[2]
184: 
185:         _LOG.debug("x_scale, y_scale, z_scale", (mhclo.x_scale, mhclo.y_scale, mhclo.z_scale))
186:         _LOG.debug("x_size, y_size, z_size", (x_size, y_size, z_size))
187: 
188:         mesh = mhclo.clothes.data
189:         assert isinstance(mesh, bpy.types.Mesh)
190: 
191:         edit_bmesh = None
192:         current_shape_settings = None
193:         current_active_object = bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active
194: 
195:         # If the mesh has shape keys, switch to edit mode to update.
196:         if mesh.shape_keys and len(mesh.shape_keys.key_blocks) > 0:
197:             bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = mhclo.clothes
198: 
199:             current_shape_settings = (mhclo.clothes.active_shape_key_index,
200:                                       mhclo.clothes.use_shape_key_edit_mode,
201:                                       mhclo.clothes.show_only_shape_key)
202: 
203:             mhclo.clothes.active_shape_key_index = 0
204:             mhclo.clothes.use_shape_key_edit_mode = True
205:             mhclo.clothes.show_only_shape_key = True
206: 
207:             bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='EDIT', toggle=False)
208:             assert mhclo.clothes.mode == 'EDIT'
209: 
210:             edit_bmesh = bmesh.from_edit_mesh(mesh)
211:             clothes_vertices = edit_bmesh.verts
212: 
213:         else:
214:             clothes_vertices = mesh.vertices
215: 
216:         _LOG.debug("About to try to match vertices: ", len(clothes_vertices))
217:         _LOG.dump("Verts", mhclo.verts)
218: 
219:         for clothes_vertex_number, clothes_vertex in enumerate(clothes_vertices):
220:             vertex_match_info = mhclo.verts[clothes_vertex_number]
221:             _LOG.dump("Vertex match info", (clothes_vertex_number, vertex_match_info))
222:             (human_vertex1, human_vertex2, human_vertex3) = vertex_match_info["verts"]
223: 
224:             # test if we inside mesh, if not, no chance
225:             #
226:             if human_vertex1 >= human_vertices_count or human_vertex2 > human_vertices_count or human_vertex3 >= human_vertices_count:
227:                 continue
228: 
229:             offset = [vertex_match_info["offsets"][0] * x_size, vertex_match_info["offsets"][1] * z_size, vertex_match_info["offsets"][2] * y_size]
230:             clothes_vertex.co = \
231:                 vertex_match_info["weights"][0] * human_vertices[human_vertex1].co + \
232:                 vertex_match_info["weights"][1] * human_vertices[human_vertex2].co + \
233:                 vertex_match_info["weights"][2] * human_vertices[human_vertex3].co + \
234:                 Vector(offset)
235: 
236:         if edit_bmesh:
237:             bmesh.update_edit_mesh(mesh, destructive=False)
238: 
239:             bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='OBJECT', toggle=False)
240: 
241:             (mhclo.clothes.active_shape_key_index,
242:              mhclo.clothes.use_shape_key_edit_mode,
243:              mhclo.clothes.show_only_shape_key) = current_shape_settings
244: 
245:             bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = current_active_object
246: 
247:         # We need to take into account that the base mesh might be rigged. If it is, we'll want the rig position
248:         # rather than the basemesh position
249:         if set_parent:
250:             if basemesh.parent:
251:                 clothes.location = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
252:                 clothes.parent = basemesh.parent
253:             else:
254:                 clothes.location = basemesh.location
255: 
256:         # As we are finished with the combined shape key we can now remove it
257:         basemesh.shape_key_remove(shape_key)

1552:     def add_builtin_rig(basemesh, rig_name, *, import_weights=True, operator=None):
1553:         """
1554:         Adds a built-in rig to the given basemesh.
1555: 
1556:         Args:
1557:             basemesh (bpy.types.Object): The basemesh object to which the rig will be added.
1558:             rig_name (str): The name of the rig to be added. If it starts with "rigify.", it will be treated as a Rigify rig.
1559:             import_weights (bool): Whether to import weights for the rig. Default is True.
1560:             operator (bpy.types.Operator, optional): The operator calling this function, used for reporting errors. Default is None.
1561: 
1562:         Returns:
1563:             bpy.types.Object: The created armature object, or None if the rig file could not be found.
1564:         """
1565:         is_rigify = rig_name.startswith("rigify.")
1566:         if is_rigify and not SystemService.check_for_rigify():
1567:             raise NotImplementedError("Rigify is not available, please enable it to use rigify rigs")
1568:         rig_name_base = rig_name[7:] if is_rigify else rig_name
1569: 
1570:         # Determine the rig file name
1571:         rigs_dir = LocationService.get_mpfb_data("rigs")
1572:         rigs_subdir = os.path.join(rigs_dir, "rigify" if is_rigify else "standard")
1573: 
1574:         rig_file = os.path.join(rigs_subdir, "rig." + rig_name_base + ".json")
1575: 
1576:         if not os.path.isfile(rig_file):
1577:             if operator is not None:
1578:                 operator.report({'ERROR'}, "Could not find the rig file: " + rig_file)
1579:             else:
1580:                 raise IOError("Could not find the rig file: " + rig_file)
1581:             return None
1582: 
1583:         # Load the rig from file
1584:         rig = Rig.from_json_file_and_basemesh(rig_file, basemesh)
1585:         armature_object = rig.create_armature_and_fit_to_basemesh()
1586: 
1587:         # Assign a name to the armature
1588:         name = basemesh.name + (".metarig" if is_rigify else ".rig")
1589:         armature_object.name = armature_object.data.name = name
1590: 
1591:         # Type-specific handling
1592:         if is_rigify:
1593:             assert len(armature_object.data.rigify_colors) > 0
1594: 
1595:             if hasattr(armature_object.data, 'rigify_rig_basename'):
1596:                 armature_object.data.rigify_rig_basename = "Human.rigify"
1597: 
1598:         else:
1599:             RigService.normalize_rotation_mode(armature_object)
1600: 
1601:         # Parent the mesh to the rig
1602:         basemesh.parent = armature_object
1603: 
1604:         armature_object.location = basemesh.location
1605:         basemesh.location = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
1606: 
1607:         # Load weights and create the armature modifier
1608:         if import_weights:
1609:             for try_rig in RigService.get_rig_weight_fallbacks(rig_name):
1610:                 if try_rig.startswith("rigify."):
1611:                     try_rig = try_rig[7:]
1612: 
1613:                 weights_file = os.path.join(rigs_subdir, "weights." + try_rig + ".json")
1614: 
1615:                 if os.path.isfile(weights_file):
1616:                     RigService.load_weights(armature_object, basemesh, weights_file)
1617:                     break
1618:             else:
1619:                 if operator is not None:
1620:                     operator.report({'ERROR'}, "Could not find the weights file")
1621: 
1622:             RigService.ensure_armature_modifier(basemesh, armature_object)
1623: 
1624:         return armature_object
